message: v10.7.10 makes datacenter serving a hard 100% ceiling: excess subscription/API demand becomes unserved traffic and paused customers, while language-model revenue and serving cost follow the share the fleet can actually serve. The capacity graph never exceeds 100% and shows traffic served, unserved demand and paused customers separately. It also fixes the Model Type selector getting stuck on Cybersecurity AI and adds a global interaction-stability guard so automatic simulation renders no longer replace buttons, sliders or selects underneath the mouse and cause hover flicker or missed clicks. Existing v10.7.9 Sandbox physical-serving fix, optimization, licensing and human-voice tutorial remain included.
